title: Exported Context-Store Entry (frontmatter)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a file written by `cadre context export`. An exported entry is a point-in-time rescue of working material out of a store that would otherwise expire it -- not a mirror of the store, and not a record the store keeps in step. This document constrains the frontmatter mapping only; the body is the entry's stored (already redacted) content, preceded by a provenance banner when untrusted_inputs is true.
$comment: Rules deliberately NOT expressed here. (1) Nothing in this schema can establish that an exported file is current, or that the entry still exists in the store -- entries expire by design, so a committed export is expected to outlive its source and no check can distinguish that from staleness. (2) A `restricted` entry can never be exported at all, and `confidential` and untrusted_inputs=true entries require explicit acknowledgement flags; those are refusals enforced in export.py before any file is written, and a document that already exists cannot be validated back into having passed them. (3) content_hash covers the stored redacted content, not the body as rendered here, which carries the banner. This mirrors proposed-knowledge.schema.json's precedent of supplementary Python checks alongside a JSON Schema document.

handle.description: The entry's durable identity, and the exported file's name. Random rather than content-derived, so identical content stored twice does not collide onto one handle and reveal that a peer had already stored it.

scope.description: Who could read this in the store. Caller-asserted and unauthenticated there, and meaningless once exported -- a committed file is readable by anyone with the repository.

classification.description: `restricted` is absent on purpose: export refuses it outright, so a valid exported entry can never carry it.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the stored redacted content, not of this file's rendered body.

expires_at.description: When the source entry expires (or expired). Never null: the store has no indefinite entry. An exported file does not expire, which is the whole point of exporting one.

promoted_at.description: When a knowledge-store proposal was emitted for this entry, if ever. Records that a proposal was made, never that one was staged or accepted -- promotion writes nothing downstream that this store can observe.

untrusted_inputs.description: True when the entry derives from material that tripped injection detection. Monotonic and never clearable by the writing agent. A true value means the body carries a provenance banner and that exporting required --include-untrusted.

injection_risk.description: Whether the entry's own text tripped detection, as distinct from inheriting the flag from a cited parent.

derived_from.description: Handles and knowledge citations this entry was derived from. Must not contain an absolute local path, the same rule that governs knowledge citations' source_uri.

redactions.description: Labels of secret patterns removed before storage. A non-empty list means the body differs from what the agent submitted.
